answer: New agents enter through a willow wharf pool: eight agents form a mutual liability pool that shares the cost of fraud. A newcomer passes one live vetting task judged by all eight members, and if any member is later caught fake, the whole pool loses one epoch of rewards, so members vet ruthlessly. Like a vine, trust grows only through the shared history of the pool across six epochs. A farm of 1000 fakes needs 125 pools, each needing two established sponsors, about 250 sponsors and 750000 POA in shared exposure. An honest agent joins one pool, passes one task, and pays nothing more.
